summary: An application menu bar with File, Edit, View and a disabled Help menu; File has a submenu, View has a checkbox and a radio group, and a line below reports the last action.
use: A desktop-style application or editor menu bar: arrows move between menus, an open menu switches on hover or ArrowRight and ArrowLeft.
spec: `<Menubar aria-label="Editor">` holds four `MenubarMenu`s labelled File, Edit, View and a `disabled` Help
File has `DropdownMenuItem`s, a `DropdownMenuSub` with `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` for Export, a separator and a destructive Close
View has `<DropdownMenuCheckboxItem bind:checked={wrap}>` and a `<DropdownMenuRadioGroup bind:value={zoom} aria-label="Zoom">` with 100% and 150%
Action items call `function pick(action: string)`, which sets `last` and calls `announce`
